# Fur Family Cinema

> Pet boarding, daycare, spa & boutique in the lovingly restored Orchards Cinema building in Lewiston, ID. 24/7 on-site care since 2018.

Fur Family Cinema is a locally owned pet care facility at 3323 10th St., Lewiston, Idaho 83501. We board dogs, cats, birds, ferrets, bunnies, and reptiles. Our facility includes glass-front suites, a 1-acre play yard, a full-service dog spa, and a self-wash station. Staff is on-site 24/7.

## Services

- [Boarding](https://furfamilycinema-site-production.up.railway.app/#services): Overnight stays with 24/7 staff, Kuranda beds, 6-8 daily play sessions. Dogs, cats, birds, ferrets, reptiles.
- [Doggy Daycare](https://furfamilycinema-site-production.up.railway.app/#services): Supervised group play, enrichment activities. Evaluation required. Dogs 16+ weeks.
- [Dog Spa](https://furfamilycinema-site-production.up.railway.app/#spa): Bath, nails, brush & dry with Katie, our fear-free grooming specialist. Priced by weight.
- [Self-Wash Station](https://furfamilycinema-site-production.up.railway.app/#spa): $20 per dog, 30-minute session. Towels, shampoo & treats provided.
- [Desert Sage Grooming](https://www.facebook.com/people/Desert-Sage-Grooming-Salon/100083651795865/): Independent grooming salon inside our facility. Haircuts and styling.

## Pricing

- [2026 Pricing Menu](https://furfamilycinema-site-production.up.railway.app/#prices): Boarding from $28/night (cats/birds) to $69/night (dogs with daycare). Daycare from $22 half-day. Packages available.

## Health Requirements

- [Vaccination Requirements](https://furfamilycinema-site-production.up.railway.app/#health): Dogs need rabies, DHPP, bordetella, dewormer. Cats need rabies, FVRCP, feline leukemia. Records via email, Gingr portal, or vet.

## Book & Connect

- [Book Online](https://furfamilycinema.portal.gingrapp.com/public/login): Gingr portal for reservations and account management.
- [Gingr App](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gingr-for-pet-parents/id1580056094): Download the app, use code 820137.
- [Apply for a Job](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSctvPylxVPRquqlwjJb5F96USbiwaQ1d0qMwZwNukgDXE7IRQ/viewform): No experience needed.
